no_adcom_quote.quote: There was no advisory committee meeting or other external consultations for this NDA review.

summary: No FDA advisory committee was convened for the Cerianna (fluoroestradiol F-18) NDA212155 review. Section 9 of the Multidisciplinary Review explicitly states there was no advisory committee meeting or other external consultations for this NDA. Other 'committee' mentions in the review refer to the NRC's Advisory Committee on Medical Uses of Isotopes (ACMUI) cited in the literature on breast-feeding interruption guidance, not an FDA advisory committee for this application.
